note: The loud front (GDD §07 loud; Keel N10): loop the camera and reroute the patrol, shoot the guard, enter (68 s at Alert 2), take Vale out and fight the police at the getaway car with the whole armed cell. No contact. The Tech and the Enforcer run (free once the run is loud; before it, noticed). Once the guard is shot the Scout, Fixer and Tech run to cover by the car and draw; the Enforcer brings Vale to the car under their cover; once the response unit is down the Scout and Tech close on the officers holding at the café wall, the Fixer carries the downed Scout to the car, and the Enforcer extracts when the last officer is down and nobody is left behind (Motive's loud-carry, briefs/011/motive-fights.md: the reference loud leaves no one captured): the fastest loud win the checker knows, which the informed quiet route must not be slower than (T2).
